Premium services & pricing

Three packages, with add-ons for specific needs.

Express Shine

$100 – $140

Fast, high-quality maintenance clean for well-kept vehicles.

  • Exterior: Hand wash, streak-free window cleaning, wheel & tire scrub, tire shine.
  • Interior: Complete vacuum, dash & console wipe down, door jamb wipe down.

Interior Revival

$175 – $225

Deep cleaning focused on restoring the inside of your vehicle.

  • Deep Carpet & Seat Scrub: Agitation and high-powered extraction to lift stains.
  • Steam Sanitization: Vents, cup holders, crevices and hard surfaces.
  • Leather & Vinyl: Deep cleaned and conditioned to prevent cracking.
  • Finishing Touches: Streak-free glass interior/exterior, odor elimination treatment.

The Signature Detail

$320 – $400

Our comprehensive package combining deep interior restoration with exterior protection.

  • Complete Interior Revival: Deep extraction, steam cleaning, leather conditioning.
  • Complete Exterior Armor: Clay bar decontamination, paint polish, 6-month sealant.
  • Engine Bay: Light wipe-down and plastic dressing.
  • Estimated Time: 4 to 5.5 hours.
